title: beach club
content: last night i had a dream i was at a beach club in mall world. when i woke up i could barely remember it let alone describe it, as it seemed i was only there for a couple of seconds. i was at a couple other places including the mall itself for a lot longer periods of time but that’s not really relevant to the beach club. has anyone else been to the beach club before? it was just snowing out in a different scene why are we at a beach club?
